title: cyclosorus bordenii
intro: Cyclosorus bordenii, commonly known as the Borden's fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including the reduction of inflammation and the improvement of respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cyclosorus bordenii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. Bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties, although more research is needed to fully understand its effects.
